messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] +J model causing R to crash
parts:
Hi,

There haven't been any updates that touched this area.

The only thing I've ever heard/noticed about this, mostly several years ago, is that sometimes BAYAREALIKE or BAYAREALIKE+J crashes, typically on Windows machines. 

The main solutions are/were:

1. Narrow the parameter limits a bit -- e.g. after setting up the model, check/edit the parameters table:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table

- change the "min" for j from 0.00001 to 0.001 
- change the "min" for d from 0.000000000001 (whatever it is) to 0.001 

...this seems to help avoid numeric underflow problems on some machines.


2. There is a newish option as well, which, if a particular combination of parameter values causes a NaN error (Not A Number), will replace the NaN likelihood with a low value, allowing the Maximum Likelihood search to continue without crashing.

Again, before running the search, set this default minimum log-likelihood like this:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object$on_NaN_error = -1e50

Cheers,
Nick
